content: If the return value of Dem_J1939DcmReadDiagnosticReadiness3 is unequal E_OK, the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall call J1939Rm_SendAck with parameters ‘ackCode’ Specification of a Diagnostic Communication Manager for SAE J1939 AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 35 of 97 Document ID 610 : AUTOSAR_SWS_SAEJ1939DiagnosticCommunicationManager - AUTOSAR confidential - set to J1939RM_ACK_NEGATIVE to send a negative acknowledgement (NACK) (considering [SWS_J1939Dcm_00113] ).

If the return value of Dem_J1939DcmReadDiagnosticReadiness3 is unequal E_OK, the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall call J1939Rm_SendAck with parameters ‘ackCode’ set to J1939RM_ACK_NEGATIVE to send a negative acknowledgement (NACK) (considering [SWS_J1939Dcm_00113] ).
